title: The Quiet Verdict
author: Silas Thornbury
blurb: August Marchetti, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the trial begins.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
